description: auth.md agent registration. type anonymous: get a claim_token, then call the claim endpoint with the email of the shop owner who should claim you. type service_auth: pass login_hint (that email) and get the claim code in one step. Before the claim you only reach public calls (pre_claim_scopes is empty). Optional scope narrows the key you will get (read_only, no_money); client_name is shown to the owner. identity_assertion is not accepted (issuer_not_enabled).
name: agents_register

user_code.description: 6 digit code. Show it to the person; they type it on the claim page. Never put it in a URL.

verification_uri.description: Hosted claim page for the person to open.

claim_token.description: Secret. Keep it; you poll the token endpoint with it.
